title: Steve's Custom Bosses Data pack
description: This data pack adds custom recipes, advancements, challenges, and bosses to the game, all with vanilla mechanics!
body:
This data pack adds custom recipes, advancements, challenges, and bosses to the game, all with vanilla mechanics!

**Updates every 1-2 weeks!**
Currently only for 1.21.5+ for now, back ports will be made when I find the time!

Little project I made for a server, and figured I should share it.
